definitions.explanation: An alliance of political parties that join together to form a government or achieve a shared goal. Also used in mathematics to describe simultaneous equations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連立|れんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
examples.english: Three political parties formed a coalition.

examples.japanese: {連立|れんりつ}{政権|せいけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんでいる→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: The coalition government is struggling with internal conflict.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連立|れんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}して→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}む→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The opposition parties dissolved their coalition and each went their own way.

notes:
Primarily a political term describing an alliance between parties. Very common in Japanese news and political reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連立|れんりつ}{政権|せいけん} (coalition government)
- {連立|れんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to form a coalition)
- {連立|れんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧ (to dissolve a coalition)
- {連立|れんりつ}⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧ (coalition ruling parties)

Also used in mathematics: {連立|れんりつ}⟦{方程式|ほうていしき}→方程式：04795_houteishiki⟧ means simultaneous equations.
